errors.text_span: а най-висок процент от изследваните общини с население до 10 000 души и градските общини е 31,1%
errors.evidence: The phrasing is ambiguous and slightly inaccurate. While 31.1% is the highest percentage among the population-based categories, it is the lower of the two values for the area type categories ('градски' vs 'селски'). Calling it the 'highest percentage' for both is confusing.
